the weather has been really strange lately it was sunny in the morning and then around noon the sky turned dark and it started to pour for about an hour and then the sun came out again and everything looked washed and bright i decided to walk to the park near my house because i had been inside all week working on the quarterly report and my back was killing me when i got there i saw a few kids playing soccer and an old man feeding the pigeons so i sat on a bench and called my sister anna who lives in chicago we talked about our parents and whether we should plan a trip to visit them in june she thinks we should rent a cabin by the lake but i worry that it will be too expensive with the flights and the car rental and everything else so we agreed to look at prices over the weekend and decide on monday after that i walked home through the market and picked up some tomatoes basil and fresh bread for dinner i made a simple pasta with garlic olive oil and the tomatoes and it turned out better than i expected my neighbor tom stopped by to borrow a ladder and i invited him to stay and eat with me he told me about his new job at a software company in seattle and how nervous he was about the first week i told him not to worry because everyone is nervous at the start and it usually gets easier after a few days we ended up talking until late in the evening about work and travel and the best places to get coffee in the city and when he finally left i felt tired but happy so i washed the dishes set an alarm for six and went to bed early send it to mom call me when you get because they're stuck in traffic i've been there and i'll go again but i'd rather stay home john and sarah are flying from new york to san francisco on monday we're meeting with microsoft and google Turn around. the weather has been really strange lately it was sunny in the morning and then around noon the sky turned dark and it started to pour for about an hour and then the sun came out again and everything looked washed and bright i decided to walk to the park near my house because i had been inside all week working on the quarterly report and my back was killing me when i got there i saw a few kids playing soccer and an old man feeding the pigeons so i sat on a bench and called my sister anna who lives in chicago we talked about our parents and whether we should plan a trip to visit them in june she thinks we should rent a cabin by the lake but i worry that it will be too expensive with the flights and the car rental and everything else so we agreed to look at prices over the weekend and decide on monday after that i walked home through the market and picked up some tomatoes basil and fresh bread for dinner i made a simple pasta with garlic olive oil and the tomatoes and it turned out better than i expected my neighbor tom stopped by to borrow a ladder and i invited him to stay and eat with me he told me about his new job at a software company in seattle and how nervous he was about the first week i told him not to worry because everyone is nervous at the start and it usually gets easier after a few days we ended up talking until late in the evening about work and travel and the best places to get coffee in the city and when he finally left i felt tired but happy so i washed the dishes set an alarm for six and went to bed early
